categories.title: Beeps and Boops
categories.intro: [laughs] A little robot who barely says a word, and somehow made us all cry. It's WALL-E!

clues.clue: WALL-E's job is to squash this into neat little cubes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is trash! [chuckles] Seven hundred years of tidying up. My kids could never.

clues.clue: WALL-E finds a tiny green plant and keeps it safe inside one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an old boot! [whispers] A little sprout in a big boot. The whole plot, really.

clues.clue: The Axiom's villainous ship's-wheel autopilot robot is called this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is AUTO! [dramatic pause] A big red eye that will NOT let you go home. Sound familiar?

clues.clue: This sound designer gave WALL-E his voice. He also created the beeps of R2-D2.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ben Burtt! [excited] R2-D2 AND WALL-E. The man speaks fluent robot.

clues.clue: WALL-E's name is short for Waste Allocation Load Lifter, this class.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Earth-Class! [dramatic pause] Waste Allocation Load Lifter, Earth-Class. TRUE Pixar nerd!

clues.clue: This comedian improvised his way through the role of the Genie in 1992's Aladdin.

clues.clue: Dwayne Johnson voices this shape-shifting demigod.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maui! [chuckles] What can I say except... you got it right.

clues.clue: Clarence Nash voiced this hot-tempered character for over 50 years.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Donald Duck! [laughs] Nobody could understand him... and that was the POINT.

clues.clue: Sterling Holloway voiced Winnie the Pooh, Kaa, and this grinning cat from 1951's Alice in Wonderland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Cheshire Cat! [mischievously] We're all mad here. Especially the nerds who got that one.

categories.title: Park Soundtrack
categories.intro: [excited] The parks are full of music and noise. [chuckles] Let's turn up the volume!

clues.clue: Each night the sky over the castle fills with booms, music and these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is fireworks! [excited] Kaboom! Ooh! Ahh! That was me, by the way.

clues.clue: The singing hosts of Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room are four of these birds.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is parrots! [laughs] Jose, Michael, Pierre and Fritz. All the birds sing words!

clues.clue: Steam whistles echo around Magic Kingdom from this train, which stops at Main Street, Frontierland and Fantasyland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Walt Disney World Railroad! [excited] All aboard! Toot toot! That one's for the train nerds.

clues.reveal: The correct answer is a barbershop quartet! [laughs] Straw hats, striped vests and perfect harmony.

clues.reveal: The correct answer is Paul Frees! [dramatic pause] Thurl Ravenscroft is a singing bust. TRUE mansion nerds knew it.
